messages:
Kai: FYI vendor (CloudRack) emailed — partial shipment: 8x H100 arriving us-west2 next Tue morning UTC. They asked whether to reserve for demo-pool or put into burst/dedicated inventory.
Maria: Nice. Do we have quota in redwood-demo-usw2 to attach them? Demo pool currently uses A100s so curious re: project limits.
Devon: GCP quotas are per-project + per-GPU-type. I can check but need the target project/zone — which one are we planning?
Kai: Target project: `redwood-demo-usw2`, zone `us-west2-a`. If that's tight we can try `redwood-staging` as fallback.
procurement-bot: PO#9523 status update: partial ship scheduled 2026-03-24T08:00Z. 8x H100-80GB. Serial assignment pending (vendor to provide 24-72h before attach).
Ashley: @Devon can you run a quick quota check? If it's full we'll need an emergency bump or reassign.
Devon: Running quick check... output: `gcloud compute regions describe us-west2 --project=redwood-demo-usw2 --flatten=quotas --filter="metric:GPUS (H100)"` -> quota 48, usage 48. So currently exhausted.
Maria: OK. That means no straight attach to demo project.
Kai: Can we reassign any dedicated capacity to free 8 GPUs temporarily or request a short-term top-up from cloud vendor?
Devon: There's an open terraform PR (#842) to increase quota but it's blocked on finance owner approval. I can open an emergency quota request form to the cloud account team but it needs billing-owner sign-off.
Ashley: Who's billing owner for redwood-demo-usw2? Priya usually owns billing for demo projects — @Priya can you chime in?
Kai: If finance can't turn quickly, alternative is to route the shipment to `redwood-staging` which shows spare H100 quota (12/40 used). But note staging is under a different org folder; cross-project attach may require vendor and cloud account ops coordination.
Devon: Quick vendor policy check: cross-project hardware assignment possible but vendor requires destination project manifest and acceptance 24h before rack attach. Also billing account on the destination must be pre-authorized. I'll validate specifics and write a short runbook.
procurement-bot: Vendor note added to PO#9523: "Cross-project attach allowed if manifest submitted 24h prior and destination billing verified."
Maria: Timeline: shipping window looks tight (24-26 Mar). We need decisions within 48h.
Kai: Action items: 1) Devon — confirm cross-project attach steps and produce runbook (ETA 2h). 2) Maria — draft emergency quota justification to finance and update PR description (ETA EOD). 3) Ashley — ping vendor-ops to confirm they accept cross-project manifests and whether they can delay attach until we sort billing (ETA 1h).
Devon: Ran quick validation: yes, cross-project attach doable. Minimal runbook (draft): `1) submit hardware manifest with destination project id 24h prior; 2) vendor attaches to datacenter cage; 3) cloud infra maps GPUs to destination project during host registration; 4) post-attach network/billing validation`. I'll paste the runbook to the repo shortly.
Ashley: I'll ping vendor-ops and vendor account manager now and copy this thread.
procurement-bot: PO#9523 updated: serials assigned 4/8 so far, remaining 4 pending. Shipping window narrowed to 2026-03-24..2026-03-26 UTC.
Kai: Good. If finance stalls, fallback is staging + short-lived access tokens for demos (risk: extra access controls).
Maria: I'll add staging fallback notes to the PR and tag @finance-team.
Devon: Runbook link posted: https://confluence.redwood.ai/infra/h100-cross-project-runbook (draft). Also added checklist to PR #842.
Kai: Thanks all — we'll reconvene once Devon confirms final manifest steps and Ashley confirms vendor Ops. :thumbsup:
